description_en: Clones an existing data source to create a new one
description_zh: 根据已有的数据源，克隆一条新的数据源
name: CloneDataSource

parameters.help_en: The ID of the data source, which is the unique identifier of the data source. You can call the ListDataSources operation to query existing data sources and their unique IDs
parameters.help_zh: 数据源ID，数据源的唯一标识符。 您可以调用 ListDataSources 查询已有数据源及其唯一 ID
parameters.name: id

parameters.help_en: The name of the target data source. The name can contain letters, digits, and underscores (_), and cannot start with a digit or an underscore. The name can be up to 60 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 目标数据源的名称，由字母、数字、下划线组合，且不能以数字和下划线开头，最长60个字符
parameters.name: clone_data_source_name

Id.description_en: The ID of the cloned data source, which is the unique identifier of the data source
Id.description_zh: 返回克隆创建的数据源ID，数据源的唯一标识符

RequestId.description_en: The request ID. You can use the ID to locate logs and troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 请求 ID。用于定位日志，排查问题
